protocol.isolation: detached competitor worktree with no Morphloom source access

integrityFindings: The detail inventory floor was reduced to zero and the detail list was emptied.
Only one view-evidence record remained despite four supplied source views.
The 38-wire repetition system maps to one wire-guards bundle, so the claimed per-wire editability is not represented by stable component IDs.
The quality target and repetition system specify three blades while the component inventory contains four blades.
Reference-derived PBR was disabled even though photographs were supplied and visual surface fidelity was requested.
Procedural material URLs and claimed resolutions are metadata; no inspectable reference-derived PBR image payload was delivered.
Only 8 of the 20 declared component pivots appear in the generated TypeScript source.
Every non-endpoint BoxGeometry is scaled by 1,1,1 instead of the declared component dimensions, so the recovered render is a stack of unit primitives rather than the planned fan.

compatibilityRecovery.reason: The generated factory used non-fetchable procedural:// URLs as reference textures and stored a circular runtime object in userData. Deterministic one-pixel channel-safe placeholders and removal of that circular metadata were required only to inspect geometry and exportability.

knownQualityBlockers: The latest four-view silhouette gate still fails on the right and left views.
Ground-truth surface distance and coverage gates still fail.
Reference-derived PBR evidence coverage is not yet sufficient for production delivery.

comparison.deliveryReason: Morphloom delivered a validated 101-mesh, independently reopenable and component-editable GLB. The competitor source required compatibility recovery and then delivered only 8 unit-primitive meshes with no component-edit proof.

sameGroundTruthSurfaceComparison.interpretation: Morphloom is substantially closer on the same ground-truth geometry, but still fails the absolute release thresholds.

comparison.visualIneligibilityReason: A locked neutral three-view render and an order-reversed two-model-family blind audit now exist. All four low-model ratings prefer Morphloom, but the material result required compatibility repair and no calibrated matched-reference, balanced five-human-rater blind panel has been recorded.
productionDominanceBlockers: No calibrated matched-reference, balanced five-human-rater blind panel exists for this run; the available four ratings come from two CLI model families.
The competitor render needed compatibility recovery, so it is ineligible for a reference-material fidelity claim.
Morphloom still fails its own side-view silhouette, reference-surface, and evidence-derived PBR gates.
One fan case cannot establish cross-domain superiority.

blockedFailureClasses: repeated-part bundling behind one edit ID
reference-PBR disabling with image-conditioned surface goals
neutral-render top/bottom clipping hidden by a wide aspect ratio
